hydraulicCalculator.title: Hydraulic System Calculator
hydraulicCalculator.placeholder: Please enter pump displacement, motor speed, and pressure. Other fields are optional.

info.pumpDisplacement: Volume of oil the pump delivers per revolution. Found on the pump nameplate, e.g. 10 cc/rev.
info.motorRpm: Rotational speed of the electric motor driving the pump. Standard AC motors run at ~1450 rpm.
info.pressure: System working pressure. Industrial hydraulic systems commonly operate at 100–250 bar.
info.bore: Inner diameter of the cylinder barrel (the piston diameter). It determines the push force.
info.rod: Diameter of the piston rod. Used to find the pull-side (annulus) area for retraction.
info.stroke: Total travel of the piston from fully retracted to fully extended position.

hydraulicCalculator.disclaimer: This calculation tool was developed by Hidroteknik A.Ş. It is provided for informational purposes only; calculation accuracy is not guaranteed. Please verify results before making technical decisions.

diagram.hint: Stroke = the piston travel inside the barrel. The part of the rod that stays outside even when fully retracted (dead length) is NOT part of the stroke.

accumulator.title: Accumulator Sizing
accumulator.note: Calculation based on Boyle's Law (isothermal). Add 25–30% safety margin for actual selection. Pre-charge pressure is typically set to 90% of minimum working pressure.

about.title: About this app
about.body:
Hydraulic & Pneumatic Calculator is the digital outcome of Hidroteknik A.Ş.'s more than 40 years of field experience.

Since 1984, Hidroteknik has been active in hydraulic and pneumatic systems, automation solutions, manufacturing, and engineering. We are not only an equipment supplier, but also an engineering organization that works on-site, develops projects, and builds complete systems.

This application was created as a result of practical calculation needs identified over many years. It is designed to provide, in one fast and accessible place, the daily essentials used by engineers, technicians, and machine manufacturers:

- pressure, flow, and power calculations
- cylinder and motor selection support
- mechanical strength and sizing checks
- fast and reliable preliminary calculations

Hidroteknik's approach is simple: combine theory with practice. Not only formulas, but calculations that deliver real value in the field.

Today, this app aims to be a practical assistant for everyone working with industrial automation and fluid power systems. Because in the real world, accurate calculations mean time and cost efficiency.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body:
We value your privacy. Hydraulic & Pneumatic Calculator primarily performs calculations on-device and does not require mandatory collection of personal data.

Calculation inputs entered in the app are not shared with third parties by default. In user-initiated actions such as bug reporting, only the information you explicitly choose to share is transmitted.

To improve app security and performance, anonymous technical data may be used in future versions. If such a change is introduced, this policy will be updated and communicated clearly.

By using this app, you agree to review this privacy policy periodically for updates. For any privacy-related questions, please contact us via hidroteknik.com.tr.

advancedHydraulic.title: Advanced Hydraulic System
advancedHydraulic.intro: Group multiple cylinders into stages. Cylinders in the same stage run SIMULTANEOUSLY (flows add up); different stages run SEQUENTIALLY. The pump is sized for the highest-flow stage.
advancedHydraulic.motorRpmInfo: Speed of the electric motor driving the pump. Standard AC motors run at ~1450 rpm. The suggested pump displacement is based on this value.
advancedHydraulic.placeholder: Enter bore, speed and pressure for at least one cylinder.
advancedHydraulic.disclaimer: Results are for preliminary sizing. Verify pressure drop, simultaneity factor and efficiency for the final selection.

info.bore:
The INNER diameter of the cylinder barrel (= piston diameter). Listed as "bore" or "Ø" in catalogs.

Common bore sizes: 25 · 32 · 40 · 50 · 63 · 80 · 100 · 125 · 160 · 200 mm.
info.rod:
The diameter of the piston rod extending outside the barrel. Optional — if omitted, retraction (annulus side) is not calculated.

Example: 63/36 cylinder → 63 mm bore, 36 mm rod.
info.stroke: The full travel of the piston from retracted to extended. Optional — omitting stroke does not affect flow or force, only cycle time.
info.speed:
Target extend speed of the piston.

Typical values:
• Heavy press / stamping: 5–20 mm/s
• General manufacturing: 20–100 mm/s
• Agricultural / tractor: 50–150 mm/s
• Excavator / mobile: 80–250 mm/s
• Platform / elevator: 10–50 mm/s

Lower speed → smaller pump, higher speed → larger pump.
info.pressure:
Working (gauge) pressure for this cylinder.

Reference:
• Low-pressure circuits: 50–100 bar
• Industrial machinery: 100–200 bar
• High-force presses: 200–350 bar

Each cylinder can have a different pressure; system pressure is the maximum entered.
